name: Apex Solventless Live Rosin O2 Disposable | Strawguava
description:
Strawguava is a very well known cannabis strain that produces large flowers packed with strawberry guava aromas! Strawguava is a cross of two other well known strains, Strawnana and Papaya, and it exemplifies the best of each. The fruity nugs are jammed with large trichome glands that wash off the plant easily, creating very cream colored, pure and clean bubble hash. The rosin that is pressed from the bubble hash retains all the flavors and nuances the hash holds while curing into a creamy white badder that is not only a joy to consume, but also refreshing to simply smell.

Cross: Strawnana 14'r x Papaya

Terp Profile: Sweet, Vanilla, Strawberry
